_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb; OpenSource/CanvasEditor/mirror.json documents the schema). Same laws as the AI mirror next door: the monorepo is the source of truth, the mirror root is the package root so Package.swift resolves for SPM, `vendor` grafts the base corpus in at conformance/local (the second path OpenSource/Local/conformance/run.ts already probes, so `node conformance/run.ts` runs standalone there), the `check` is Linux-only with no Swift step, and `tag_from` is the bare VERSION file. EVERY include path must be git-TRACKED when the lane runs: the mirror lane works from a fresh clone, git does not track empty folders, and a missing include path is a hard abort. That is the one thing to re-check when this list grows.
